diagnosis.summary: Run 605ad45a failed at ingest for 2026-10-01 because upstream sent a cut-off orders.csv. The last line is '13666,952,2' (3 of 7 fields), there's no trailing newline, and only 265 rows arrived when recent days have about 420-530. The order_items and payments files for the same day are complete and go up to order ~13841, so about 175 orders are missing. Remediation: ask upstream to re-export orders for 2026-10-01 and rerun; if the new file is also broken, escalate to upstream_app_team.

root_cause.explanation: The orders export for 2026-10-01 stopped partway through. The header matches the contract, but the file ends in the middle of a row ('13666,952,2', 3 of 7 fields, no trailing newline). The strict CSV parser rejected it, so ingest failed. Only orders is affected: order_items and payments for the same day are complete and reference orders up to ~13841.

evidence.claim: Ingest failed loading raw.orders: CSV line 266 '13666,952,2' has 3 columns where 7 are expected
The orders landing file has the contract header but stops mid-row: 265 data rows, last line has 3 fields, no trailing newline
265 rows is well below the normal 412-534 rows per orders partition
Sibling files for the same day are complete and reference orders up to ~13841, so the orders file is missing about 175 orders
The runbook says a corrupt or truncated landing file should be fixed with upstream redelivery, not by editing the file

alternatives_considered: Schema change (column added or dropped): ruled out because the header matches the contract exactly and only the last line is malformed
Transient failure / rerun_only: ruled out because the file itself is broken, so a rerun would fail the same way
Null-padding or skipping the bad row: rejected because it would silently drop about 175 orders
Including order_items and payments in the redelivery: not needed because those files are complete

proposal.rationale: The orders.csv delivered for 2026-10-01 was cut off partway through: the last line '13666,952,2' has 3 of 7 fields, there's no trailing newline, and only 265 data rows came through when recent partitions have about 420-530. The order_items and payments files for the same day are complete and reference orders up to about 13841, so roughly 175 orders are missing from the orders file. The header matches the contract, so this is a one-off interrupted export, not a schema change. Per the runbook, ask upstream to re-export orders for that day and rerun. Don't trim or null-pad the file, because that would hide the missing rows.
